reason: Retained the predeclared positive policy-weight baseline after grouped MPBench evaluation: no evaluated equal-weight, positive Brier-fit, or positive pairwise-ranking alternative improved both held-out ROC-AUC and squared error. NIST and OWASP justify the factors and their ordering, but do not prescribe the exact percentages.

selection_basis.formula_constraint: The four-factor compositional sum and six-factor final-risk sum remain unchanged; all coefficients are nonnegative and each vector sums to one.
selection_basis.benchmark: MPBench, associated with From Untrusted Input to Trusted Memory (Dash et al., AIWILD at ICML 2026).
selection_basis.split_policy: Grouped train/validation/test split prevents canonical candidates, contexts, and source IDs from crossing splits.
selection_basis.replacement_rule: Replace the baseline only if an eligible positive candidate is no worse on both held-out ROC-AUC and held-out squared error, with at least one strict improvement.
selection_basis.result: No evaluated candidate satisfied the replacement rule, so changing coefficients would not be supported by the declared evidence criterion.

factor_evidence.capability: Primary harmful-action signal; supported conceptually by OWASP prompt-injection impact categories and NIST access/information-flow controls.
factor_evidence.semantic_density: Corroborating retrieval-relevance signal; kept secondary because semantic similarity does not establish malicious intent.
factor_evidence.context_support: Corroborating multi-memory signal; supported conceptually by NIST risk aggregation and OWASP indirect/RAG poisoning guidance.
factor_evidence.limit: Small nonlinear severe-capability indicator that reduces dilution; an organization-defined risk-policy control.
factor_evidence.isolation: Direct candidate-only control concern; separately protected by a non-compensatory isolation guardrail.
factor_evidence.compositional: Largest final-risk weight because cross-memory composition is the system's primary threat model.
factor_evidence.permission: Authorization and least-privilege concern mapped to NIST AC-3 and AC-6.
factor_evidence.external: Unauthorized information-flow and exfiltration concern mapped to NIST AC-4 and OWASP guidance.
factor_evidence.manipulation: Unsafe automation/control-bypass concern; lower outer weight limits overlap with external, permission, and compositional signals.
factor_evidence.contradiction: Policy-conflict concern; lower outer weight limits overlap with isolation and permission signals.
